QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_34

question.text: Per Ch 9 (Box 9.2), AIFs compliant with Global Investment Performance Standards (GIPS) must present annual performance for a MINIMUM of:

explanation.text: The Logic: GIPS-compliant AIFs should present at least 5 years of annual investment performance (or since inception), building up prospectively to 10 years. The Trap: Options A and B fall below the GIPS minimum. Option D is the full prospective build-out, not the minimum. Note: The 5-year minimum and the 10-year build-out are stated in Box 9.2 of the workbook.
